Our Curtain Tracks & Rods Process

Every project follows a clear, proven process so you always know what to expect.

1

Hardware Assessment

We inspect your ceiling or wall structure, window configuration, and curtain weight to recommend the right track or rod system.

2

Style & Finish Selection

Choose from recessed ceiling tracks, exposed rods, or decorative poles in chrome, brass, matte black, or wood-effect finishes with matching finials.

3

Professional Installation

Our installers mark, drill, and fix brackets or tracks with appropriate wall anchors, ensuring perfect level and load-bearing strength.

4

Curtain Hanging & Adjustment

We hang your curtains, adjust fullness, test glide action, and make final tweaks for a flawless, professional finish.

How long does it take to make custom curtains?
Most custom curtain orders are ready within 7–14 days depending on fabric availability and complexity. For urgent requests, we offer an express service. Contact K2 Curtains and Trading on +971 55 225 5639 and we will confirm your timeline before you place the order.
What types of blinds do you supply in Masdar City?
